args.name: nc
args.inactive_reason: Integer column count of the launch.

args.name: icld
args.inactive_reason: Integer cloud-overlap selector; hrrrv5 = 2, maximum-random: no float output. 4 and 5 write the exponential-overlap weights.

args.name: permuteseed
args.inactive_reason: Integer KISS permutation count (1 for SW).

args.name: play
args.shape: [nc, nl] (view of a larger backing allocation)
args.inactive_reason: Layer pressure (hPa); only words j < 4 of each column are read, and they reach only the integer seeds: piecewise constant, zero derivative (frozen sample).

args.name: hgt
args.reads: all nc*nl words when icld is 4 or 5 (layer heights, m); not read otherwise

args.name: latitude
args.reads: word c (degrees), only when icld is 4 or 5 and idcor == 1

args.name: seeds
args.inactive_reason: Integer KISS state (the McICA sample stream). Piecewise constant in the play words and discontinuous at ulp scale: frozen, saved from the trajectory by __aug.

args.name: weights
args.shape: [nc, nl] when icld is 4 or 5, else a one-word dummy (not written)
args.overwrite: partial: words k = 1..nl-1 of each column when icld is 4 or 5 (the k = 0 word is never written: identity); none otherwise

saved.name: seeds
saved.what: the trajectory's McICA KISS seeds, written by __aug bitwise to the forward; never recomputed from a perturbed state by TL/AD

branches.rule: (u32)(int)(frac(play*100)*1e9): piecewise constant, zero derivative; the seeds are the trajectory's (saved)

branches.inactive_reason: icld not 4 or 5: no float word written, no derivative words.
k starts at 1: the k = 0 weight word is not written (identity on tangent and cotangent).

refusal.domain: nl >= 4; seed-layer pressure words finite and |play*100| < 2.1e9 (aug); inverse length, weights, written tangent and adjoint words finite; views do not overlap

precondition: play, hgt, latitude, seeds and weights (and their derivative mirrors) do not alias; one thread per column touches only its own words.
precision: aug: the forward word for word in f32 (__f*_rn and the forward's glibc 2.39 expf transcription gfk_exp), built --fmad=false --ftz=false --prec-div=true --prec-sqrt=true, bitwise to the forward image. tl/ad: local partials in double from the f32 primal words (dz, inverse, w, d, e), one rounding to f32 per written word; the adjoint sums the two layer terms of each height word in fixed order in double.
